rule: Designer-facing staging verb list (cutscene mode, fade to and from black, camera mode and locks, cutscene effects, play animation) with a default for each verb, and a module event for cutscene abort. In this donor most verbs are names with no handler (705 of 848 in the NWN table); PlayAnimation is bound. The GDA name table carries Boss, IsBoss and EliteBoss column names from the game data; values not in donor.
keep: Named staging verb list with defaults
Module abort event restores control when an intro is interrupted
Intro as a state, not a timer
change: Every verb bound before ship; the donor leaves most unbound
Skip is a player input event, not a designer call
Input lock applies to the player only; escorts keep acting on the server
look_test: One arena at 375 wide: one boss, 2 s intro (fade to black 0.4 s, camera lock on boss 1.5 s, boss animation, fade back) against a no-intro variant. Style flag only, preview folder, no release rows. Dom judges: does it read as a moment, does a tap to skip feel right, does it cost control he wanted. Target file src/fight/<module>.ts (module not chosen, not read); one parity row: row 11 (fight camera).
